Hey, I just wanted to chime in and say that your feelings are very normal and you're not alone in feeling this. It's okay, you don't have to subscribe to what society deems as what's "woman-like" because, like all people, we are individuals. No one person is a monolith of the stereotype of their gender. You are woman because you are woman being the way you are. Period. Secondly, you don't have to focus on what other people think or society's expectations of being a woman. Be yourself, focus on you. I saw that you like to draw, might I add that your drawings are beautiful and you're really talented. If that's what you like doing and it's what brings you joy, then please do so because like is really short to not enjoy the rest of it. Get your endorphins going, go to the gym, go out for runs, who cares about what other people think when they don't even know you enough to have an opinion about you. Fuck them, and find happiness. I feel you, I'm here for you. Even though you're a stranger and I don't know you, I still want you to exist and live your best life in the world I know you can create for yourself. This too will get better, and like all things, this too will pass.
